summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q2 2026 earnings press release, reporting net revenues of €1,938 million (up 8% YoY), EBIT of €605 million, net profit of €463 million, diluted EPS of €2.62, and industrial free cash flow of €276 million. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance, citing strong personalizations and product mix. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No strategic corporate event was announced. The filing is purely informational under Rule 13a-16.
